concepts.name: The two variance rules
concepts.summary: Var(c*X)=c^2*Var(X) (a constant comes out squared) and Var(A+B)=Var(A)+Var(B) for independent A,B (covariance term vanishes). The deliberate tools behind every noise schedule.

concepts.name: Variance-preserving mixture
concepts.summary: A mixture sqrt(a)*X + sqrt(1-a)*E of two unit-variance, independent parts keeps variance exactly 1, because the squared weights a and (1-a) sum to 1. Pure algebra from the two variance rules. (Upstairs it is diffusion's forward step, with a = 1-beta.)

concepts.name: Covariance
concepts.summary: How two quantities move together — the missing 2*Cov(A,B) term in the sum rule when variables are dependent. Upstairs it becomes VICReg's decorrelation law: drive feature covariances to zero so dimensions carry independent information.
